source_title: Median MELD at Transplant and Median PELD at Transplant, March 24, 2025
source_location: Table 1, page 47, Donor Hospital / 365-Day Cohort Dates
interpretation: New federal transplant-report evidence associates identifier 224023-NMB with Westwood Pembroke Health Systems in the 2024-03-01 through 2025-02-28 donor-hospital table. It is an auxiliary OPTN/HRSA identifier and is not a CMS enrollment/termination record, state hospital license, proof of Westwood-campus operation, or HPT pointer/MRF evidence. The 45 Clapboardtree Street campus is not specified in this row; the organization has multiple named facilities under shared ownership/licensure evidence.
evidence_gain: Adds an official 2024-25 federal identifier/operator association that postdates the reported 2017 Westwood Lodge closure; the mismatch makes effective-dated CCN/campus attribution a higher-priority reconciliation question.
disposition_effect: none; do not treat this as proof CCN 224023 remained active at 45 Clapboardtree Street or as grounds to merge with CCN 224013
next_action: Obtain the source's definition and provenance for the 224023-NMB donor-hospital identifier and an effective-dated CMS enrollment/termination or Massachusetts DMH license record tying CCN 224023 to the Westwood campus. Keep the 2024-25 auxiliary listing separate from current enrollment and HPT evidence.
